\newcount\PathStyles

\immediate\openout\PathNodes=\jobname.nodes
\let\PathFormat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\PathFormats by1
  \protected@write\PathNodes{}{ENTRY \PathCase:#1}%
  \PathFormat{#1}}
\def\PathApply{%
  \def\PathExpected{/custom/}%
  \ifx\pgfkeysdefaultpath\PathExpected\else
    \PackageError{path-test}{Payload default path changed}{The adapter must retain the path set by earlier keys.}%
  \fi
  \global\advance\PathStyles by1
  \pgfsetdash{{3pt}{2pt}}{0pt}}
\tikzset{
  /tikz/pathabsolute/.code={\PathApply},
  /custom/pathrelative/.code={\PathApply},
  /custom/line cap/.forward to=/tikz/line cap,
  line width/.append code={\pgfkeysalso{/custom/.cd}}}
\def\PathFinish#1{%
  \ifnum\PathFormats=#1\relax\else
    \PackageError{path-test}{Entry formatter count changed}{Entries must be formatted once.}%
  \fi
  \ifnum\PathStyles>0\else
    \PackageError{path-test}{No line styles executed}{The selected style must actually execute.}%
  \fi
  \typeout{PATH-OK-\PathCase}%
  \typeout{PATH-STYLES-\PathCase=\the\PathStyles}%
  \typeout{PATH-FORMATS-\PathCase=\the\PathFormats}}
\def\PathStart#1{\def\PathCase{#1}\global\PathStyles=0 \global\PathFormats=0 }
